assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The service is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes
The service is medically necessary to address the documented diagnosis codes I25.10, I34.0, and R42
The service is intended to identify the cause of the recurrent symptoms
